name: qlrisk_price_vix_future
title: Price a VIXFuture
description:
Price one VIX Future (qlrisk VIXFuture).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, ticker=SPX, strike, quantity, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
